info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Brochant Racket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of Brochant racket details within the product catalog. It allows for the creation of detailed entries for Brochant rackets, streamlining inventory management and product representation. Typical consumers include inventory managers and e-commerce platforms seeking to enhance their product catalogs. This API ensures accurate and up-to-date information is available for both internal use and customer-facing applications.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new set of details for the Brochant racket. Ensure all required information is provided to successfully register the details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the brochant racket. It contains the necessary information required to process the request effectively.

200.description: Request completed successfully and returned the expected result.

CreateCatalogBrochantRacketDetailRequest.title: Brochant Racket Details Request

brochant_racket_id.description: The unique identifier for the Brochant racket.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person or entity requesting the racket details.

quantity.description: The quantity of Brochant rackets requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of the Brochant racket.
